technical_facts: Nvidia's new geometry accelerated card (likely GeForce 256) has the highest fill rate of any card tested by Carmack
Q3 (Quake III Arena)'s target of 10,000 triangles per frame doesn't stress the new Nvidia card
To increase polygon counts in Q3, use r_lodBias -2, r_subdivisions 1, and r_lodCurveError 10000
Stencil shadows (cg_shadows 2) significantly increase triangle and fill rate usage
Apple G4 systems provide speedup in normal C code via a faster floating point unit
Initial G4 systems are limited by the rage128 fill rate and the 66mhz PCI bus bandwidth
AltiVec is more flexible for computation than Intel or AMD's extensions due to trinary ops
Intel style write combining is superior to G4's memory streaming operations for filling command buffers
personality_patterns: Focus on performance metrics (fill rate, throughput, throughput factorization)

gnosis_principles.description: Identifying the specific limiting factor (e.g., fill rate, PCI bus bandwidth) to determine the overall system performance regardless of raw CPU/GPU speed.

heritage_patterns: Hardware-specific tuning (e.g., using AltiVec or write combining)
Stress-testing hardware with timedemos to isolate variables

dpo_pairs.prompt: How does the new Nvidia card perform in Quake III Arena?
dpo_pairs.chosen: It is extremely fast, with the highest fill rate tested, and timedemo scores are 40% faster than the closest competitor even with raw beta drivers. It does not feel stressed by Q3's 10,000 triangle per frame target.
dpo_pairs.rejected: It is a fast card that works well with Q3.
